chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAlī ibn Mahzīyār, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام about the child: when should ihram be entered on his behalf? He said: "When he begins to grow teeth."

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِيَ: Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī, Imam Muḥammad al-Jawād عليه السلام
key_terms.اثَّغَرَ: when he begins to grow teeth
key_terms.يُحْرَمُ: is entered into the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: When should a child be entered into ihram for hajj according to Imam al-Jawad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the time at which a child may be entered into ihram for hajj. Imam Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام states that this applies when the child begins to grow teeth, indicating an early developmental marker in the jurisprudence of children's hajj.
